Good afternoon, Mister Luiz. This is your travel confirmation. Your flight leaves on October twenty-third, at ten in the evening, and you are going to arrive at JFK at seven in the morning. Your hotel is in Manhattan, and check-in is at three in the afternoon. You are going to receive the tickets by email today. If you are going to take extra luggage, please tell us before Friday. Thank you.

Hi Rodrigo, this is David from the New York office. Welcome in advance. Here is the plan for your first day. I am going to meet you at the hotel at eight thirty. We are going to walk to the office, it is only ten minutes. In the morning you are going to meet the team, and after lunch you are going to present the Brazilian numbers. It is going to be a good week. See you soon.

Rodrigo is going to book the flight this week. He is going to leave Sao Paulo on the twenty-third of October. He is going to arrive at the airport in New York in the morning. A car is going to take him to the hotel. After six days of work he is going to stay fourteen more days on holiday.
